messages.subject: Difficulty Installing

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Difficulty Installing
parts:
Hi,

So the line in the warning at the end "1: package(s) not installed when version(s) same as current; use `force = TRUE` to re-install: 'MSstats'" makes me think that MSstats is actually installed on your system. 

I can definitely see the error with updating nlme. I think the main error comes from the following lines:

"ld: library not found for -lgfortran
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
make: *** [nlme.so] Error 1"

It seems like this is a mac error when compiling R packages from source. Can you try the fix linked below? Seems like its worked for a few people.

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62605417/unable-to-install-r-packages-due-to-library-not-found

Devon
